content: Find Duplicates plugin (kiwidude) review UX: results are presented via a virtual-library-style search restriction (marked:duplicate_group_0001) that isolates one duplicate cluster at a time; toolbar/menu next-previous navigation moves between groups; per-group actions are delete, merge (Calibre's native merge), mark-as-exempt (persisted per-library exemption list), or skip; Escape/clear-search exits. This is a precedent for marks-based review of a proposed grouping, not a custom diff dialog.
